community.description: The community the category belongs to.

ownerOnly.description: Whether only community admins may post in the category's channels. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

allowedRoles.description: Roles allowed to post in the category's channels. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

allowedMembers.description: Members allowed to post in the category's channels in addition to allowedRoles. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

visibleToRoles.description: Roles that may read the category's channels. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

visibleToMembers.description: Members that may read the category's channels in addition to visibleToRoles. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the category.update permission, or grants visibility to a role at or above their own highest position.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: CategoryNotFound
errors.description: No category exists at the given record key.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

main.description: Updates a category's name and the permissions its channels inherit.
